required: Current phase/revision and authorized reviewer lineage
Sealed Phase 8 report and automatic successor-boundary authorization
Accepted Phase-8 successor handoff receipt bound to reviewer-5

steps.action: Open the P8_TO_P9 successor bootstrap and verify the handoff
steps.instruction: Use the GitHub connector app inside the exact campaign workspace. Exhaust the recovery ladder before any blocker message.

steps.action: Bind remediation delta and refresh the Source Intelligence bundle when required
steps.instruction: Bind old/new immutable source identities. If production source/build changed, fill a new Source Intelligence version, rebind/replace affected overlays, validate/commit them, and accept a new bundle-index revision before regression review. Compare old/new affected facts and preserve all prior revisions. If no remediation exists, record NO_REMEDIATION_ARTIFACTS_REQUIRED and reuse the matching accepted bundle.
Verify the fix addresses the validated root cause without weakening unrelated guarantees.
Do not overstate repeated same-agent or shared-harness evidence as independent.
Confirm whether remediation changes reachability, impact or final finding disposition.

Use the accepted current-source Source Intelligence as the structural baseline, then retest affected functions, invariants, integrations and regression surfaces against exact revised source. Do not rebuild unaffected structural inventories.
Retest affected economic/accounting invariants where applicable.
List stale evidence invalidated by the source delta, exact reruns, replacement evidence, residual risk and final finding states.

Update the canonical Security Traceability Graph for this phase, enumerate and reconcile every obligation due now, add stable OBL-* records for new later-phase work, and freeze current graph/ledger digests for the Phase Report. An OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation due in this phase blocks sealing. Classify every material observed change under the Evidence Invalidation Matrix before reusing affected evidence.

steps.action: File the phase report and auto-advance
steps.instruction: Seal the required structured artifact/global checkpoints, file the immutable Phase Report, enter AUTO_ADVANCE_READY, and immediately continue into the next same-reviewer phase under the Automatic Phase Advancement Protocol. Do not wait for human approval.

phaseRequirement: Add REM-* nodes or explicit no-remediation disposition; connect replacement evidence/regression tests to affected FIND-*/PROP-* nodes.

sealingCriteria: All mandatory phase-card steps completed or have a permitted typed terminal limitation/failure disposition.
Phase-specific structured filing is complete, exact-source-bound, durable, and digest-referenced.

Source Intelligence Bundle checkpoint records the accepted index revision/commit/digest plus materially used component accepted identities, matching source/build identity, reuse/regeneration status, relevant sections reviewed, and any discrepancy/invalidation/limitation; mutable-path authority and redundant structural rediscovery are forbidden.
Security Traceability Graph is updated for this phase and its current campaign-local digest/reference is recorded.
All obligations due in this phase are reconciled in the canonical obligation ledger; no due OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation remains.
Every new later-phase obligation has a stable OBL-* ID and objective completion condition.
Phase Report references phase-specific artifact, traceability graph checkpoint, obligation ledger checkpoint, evidence, limitations, and invalidation triggers.
Required process failures have exhausted repair/retry/recovery or are repaired and verified; silent omission is forbidden.
Every material observed change event is classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX; INVALIDATES/REQUIRES_REBIND work is replaced, reconciled, or carried as a typed OBL-* before sealing.
